status: experimental secondary comparator; not the Calm index
combination: equal-weight tensor average of six actor-disjoint cross-validation checkpoints
face_processing: MediaPipe eye/nose affine alignment to the RAVDESS training coordinates
sampling: at most 5 frames per second; 10% trimmed mean when at least 10 samples are available

source_checkpoint_evaluation.design: six actor-disjoint outer folds; every actor tested once

limitations: The reported metrics describe the six source checkpoints, not this averaged candidate.
RAVDESS contains acted expressions, not current perceived stress or clinical stress.
The model output is not used to calculate the visible Calm index.
No stable universal decision threshold or live-camera repeatability has been established.
The model must not be presented as a diagnosis or stress probability.
